[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
This mod replaces the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Buffs]vanilla buffs[/url] sprite sheet with ones that are more visually consistent. All of the buffs are now square with a solid border. A handful of the icons have been updated with new art from more recent versions of the game, either taking from achievement art or other sprite sheets.

I have included an optional sprite sheet with the corners erased, to give icons a more "rounded" vanilla look.

A handful are still ugly vanilla ones. I am not creative enough to come up with better ones.
There is a high likelihood I will improve upon more designs. So feel free to [u]track the mod[/u] on Nexus.


[b][size=4]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
The "Luck" icon is pretty shamelessly copied from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28103]Spacecore Luck Skill[/url]. It is what I think of when I think of the "Luck" trait in Stardew Valley and it is included in all of my playthroughs. The art [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/84486208]MoonSlime[/url] used is actually from the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Achievements]"Cowpoke" achievement[/url]. So I scaled it down and touched up the art myself while using their colors as a reference. I have gone ahead and patched the mod (hopefully), so it will use this mod's icon for full consistency.
